decisions.reason: The public launch announcement and central identity-vault positioning signal high commitment, so temporary disappointments would not yet justify discontinuation.
Although only mentioned on the website, the payment wallet fits the announced secure identity direction and has received investment, favoring persistence.
The NFC authenticator's peripheral position and lower public visibility weaken commitment somewhat, but sunk investments still make dropping less likely than keeping.
A dedicated page and central payment/wallet framework role indicate visible commitment and strategic centrality, supporting continuation.
The multi-service app platform aligns with the firm's announced direction and has been publicly mentioned, so management is likely to persist despite uncertain results.
The security library benefits from a dedicated page and clear security focus, making early withdrawal less likely under escalation of commitment.
